text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 20, 2024) for 1355 King Street West.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 20, 2024) for 1355 King Street West, Folder Number 24 198827 PRS 00 IV, and given the extremely unique circumstances of this case, in so doing granted an extension to December 31, 2029 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
